## How To Add A Snippet Of Code To The Footer Of Every Page Of A Site


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000058916

There are many 3rd party applications that require adding a snippet of code to every page on the website. To do this, we simply add the code to the Website's Footer. Place the code that the 3rd party application requires to be present on every page of the site.

Go to Settings >> Design Settings:
